fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-02-25, Arun Raj, aged 20, a college student, did not return after leaving for a bank visit; last known location was near Kadal Nagar Bus Stand Area. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-02-24 around 23:10 hrs. The complaint was lodged by Vasanth Raman (9000000051), a family member of Arun Raj, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000455. The complainant could not identify the person involved. The complainant noted the registration number TN-47-ZZ-1038 of a maroon motorcycle. The complaint refers to Babu Balan, a person who arranged the contact, reachable on 9000000231. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage. This matter may be connected to FIR-2026-00336, where the same vehicle registration TN-47-ZZ-1038 was also mentioned.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Student reportedly left for college and could not be contacted afterwards. A motorcycle was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: missing person, student, CCTV, motorcycle, night, associate, bus stand
